title: FormPage: the FORM_RECORD_ID_PARAM comment cites a resolver unreachability that PR #4318 removed
body:
Observation-class, comment-only. Filed unassigned by the #4280 dev agent (PR #4318), which created the drift and was fenced out of `FormPage.tsx` for that dispatch.

## Fact

`apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` (around line 120-125) explains why `FORM_RECORD_ID_PARAM` is a literal rather than an import:

> It is a literal here rather than an import only because `@object-ui/app-shell` exports its package root alone and that root does not re-export `./urlParams` — the same unreachability `createdRecordPath.ts` documents for `resolveHostAppSegment`.

The **claim** is still true: the root barrel still does not re-export `./urlParams`, so the literal is still justified. Only the **comparison** is stale. PR #4318 (part of #4280) published `resolveHostAppSegment` from the package root and deleted the console's local subset, so `createdRecordPath.ts` documents no such unreachability any more — it imports the resolver.

## Why this is worth recording rather than sitting on

The sentence is a cross-reference to a sibling module as the second witness for a shared constraint. A reader who follows it now finds the opposite of what it promises, which makes the surviving `./urlParams` justification read as though it had also been resolved. That is the same "two readers of one prose contract" family (#3367 / #3842) the parent card is about, one level down in the comments.

## Surface

One clause in `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`. No behaviour, no tests. The honest replacement points at the `./urlParams` fact directly instead of borrowing a sibling's now-resolved case — and could note that the resolver case was collected by #4280, which is the precedent for collecting this one too.

Refs #4280, PR #4318, #4109, #4292.
